outcomes: Define software engineering and explain why it matters.
Describe the stages of the software life cycle.
content: Software engineering applies systematic, disciplined methods to the development and maintenance of software.

content.heading: The software life cycle
content.text: Most processes share the same activities.

activities: Group discussion: a software failure you have experienced.
reading: Any standard software engineering textbook, chapter 1.

outcomes: Compare the waterfall and iterative process models.

content.heading: Waterfall
content.text: Each stage finishes before the next begins.

content.heading: Iterative and incremental
content.text: The system grows through repeated short cycles.

activities: Choose a process model for a given case and justify it.
